title: Rare 4.1-billion-year-old Martian meteorite reveals clues to planet's ancient past
description: Scientists at the University of New Mexico have played a key role in identifying a rare, 4.1-billion-year-old Martian meteorite that provides new evidence that the red planet may have once had a wetter, Earth-like environment.

title: Tuvalu faces fossil fuel dilemma in management of its national investment fund
description: Tuvalu's government is indirectly investing in fossil fuel companies through its national trust fund, with documents revealing the country has limited ability to stop.
